routing_policy.DIRECT_HISTORY_CALIBRATED: run direct-history, pooled-history, regularized, robust, ensemble, and scarcity variants
routing_policy.DIRECT_HISTORY_LIMITED: run shrinkage, pooled, comparable-assisted, robust, ensemble, and scarcity variants
routing_policy.COMPARABLE_PRODUCT_ADJUSTED: run equal-peer, similarity-weighted, age-adjusted, price-level-adjusted, robust peer median, ensemble, and scarcity variants
routing_policy.no_direct_history_policy: use governed comparable peers and peer outcome transfer; never fabricate direct history
routing_policy.no_realized_endpoint_policy: use validated shorter-horizon compounding plus comparable endpoint transfer and classify as scenario, not historically validated forecast

required_validation.minimum_sample_policy: fail closed or downgrade to scenario when endpoint sample is insufficient

winner_selection.stability_requirement: winner must remain competitive across rolling cutoffs and product holdouts
winner_selection.scarcity_requirement: scarcity variant retained only when it improves endpoint-route validation or downside-risk calibration
winner_selection.ensemble_policy: ensemble may win only when out-of-sample metrics improve and no component leakage exists

1095.fallback: validated shorter-horizon compounding plus comparable transfer

1825.fallback: scenario ensemble using validated one-year dynamics, comparable maturity curves, and uncertainty widening
